entry.title: Prognostic significance of incident microalbuminuria in a real-world population at increased cardiovascular risk: A report from a global federated research network
entry.summary: Despite growing interest in biomarker-based risk stratification for incident heart failure (HF), the prognostic value of newly detected microalbuminuria is poorly defined. This study evaluated its association with incident HF and cardiorenal outcomes in a large real-world cohort at increased cardiovascular risk.
